data.exact_reserve_text: Included within net claims incurred of GBP 140.2m (2016: GBP 102.4m) is a deterioration of GBP 19.1m (2016: deterioration of GBP 2.8m) to claims reserves established at the prior year end principally due to unfavourable developments on Professional Lines and Energy with partially offsetting favourable developments across the other classes.

prior_year_events.event_name: Late reporting developments on legacy lines
prior_year_events.impact_description: Strengthening of reserves on legacy lines on 2013 & Prior, following late reporting developments, led to a deterioration of GBP 9.3m.

prior_year_events.event_name: Adverse development on known Professional / Property / Non-Marine Liability circumstances
prior_year_events.impact_description: Adverse development on known circumstances on the Professional Lines, Property and Non-Marine Liability accounts further impacted the results on the 2015 & Prior year of account.

named_events.event_name: Hurricanes Harvey, Irma and Maria and Mexico earthquakes
named_events.loss_description: Had a significant impact particularly on the Property account with gross incurred losses of GBP 24.1m although the Syndicate's reinsurance programme, including its participation on the group catastrophe programme, significantly mitigated the impact on a net basis.

named_events.event_name: Cargo, Marine Excess of Loss and Proportional Treaty losses (Q3 2017)
named_events.loss_description: The Cargo, Marine Excess of Loss and Proportional Treaty classes were also significantly impacted by these events with gross losses of GBP 11.7m in the period.
The Non-Marine Liability account experienced a challenging year with a number of new significant losses being reported notably in relation to Californian utility business.

named_events.event_name: Pension mis-selling and case reserve developments (Professional Lines)
named_events.loss_description: A number of new significant losses, including issues regarding pension mis-selling and material development on specific case reserves impacted the Professional Lines class driving a loss of GBP 1.8m for the year before administrative expenses.

data.standardized_narrative: At 31 December 2017 the Syndicate's gross claims outstanding were GBP 324.16m. On a gross basis prior-year reserves showed a net adverse development (strengthening) of approximately GBP 36.6m (11.3% of opening gross reserves) driven principally by adverse developments in Professional Lines and Energy and by legacy reporting developments (notably 2013 & prior and 2015 & prior years). 2017 also saw significant catastrophe activity (Hurricanes Harvey, Irma and Maria and Mexico earthquakes) which produced gross incurred losses (notably GBP 24.1m in Property) but were substantially mitigated by the Syndicate's reinsurance programme. The prior year deterioration is principally attributable to adverse claims development and large loss development in the classes noted above.
raw_causal_phrases: Included within net claims incurred of GBP 140.2m (2016: GBP 102.4m) is a deterioration of GBP 19.1m (2016: deterioration of GBP 2.8m) to claims reserves established at the prior year end principally due to unfavourable developments on Professional Lines and Energy with partially offsetting favourable developments across the other classes.
Strengthening of reserves on legacy lines on 2013 & Prior, following late reporting developments, led to a deterioration of GBP 9.3m.

Hurricanes Harvey, Irma and Maria and the Mexico earthquakes had a significant impact particularly on the Property account with gross incurred losses of GBP 24.1m although the Syndicate's reinsurance programme, including its participation on the group catastrophe programme, significantly mitigated the impact on a net basis.
The 2015 year of account reinsured to close into the 2016 year of account at 31 December 2017 at a loss of GBP 19.4m which will be called in June 2018.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to Property

data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development (PYD) gross figure was derived from the gross claims development triangle (sum of changes for UW years <=2015) because the only explicit PYD sentence in the notes quoted a net deterioration (GBP 19.1m). The Syndicate disclosed an RITC (2015 into 2016) which may distort development patterns; therefore the PYD computed from the triangle is subject to this caveat. Narrative net figures cited in the report are NET of reinsurance; where the report quoted net deterioration these were NOT used for the gross PYD. Opening gross claims outstanding was taken from the Technical Provisions table and is explicit.
